$comment: requires_bootstrap is the call shape this plugin needs: shipped skill text launches scripts as "${BOOTSTRAP_PYTHON:?requires bootstrap >= 0.120.0}", which only bootstrap 0.120.0's SessionStart hook exports. The venv carries the dryer and crapper console scripts from the git commits pyproject.toml pins; the runner refuses a venv whose installed commit differs. git is declared because the runner snapshots the target with git archive and git ls-files. The custom bootstrap script fetches the tree-sitter parser bundle (about 26 MB) into the plugin data directory, so installing clean-code-kit opts into that download.
